mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in the Consumer Price Index above 0.5% signals rising inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market that may lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, strong GDP growth (GDPC1 above 2% annualized) signals economic overheating and impending monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in late-cycle expansions when GDPC1 is above 2% annualized (t-test p > 0.05) or the regime-specific effect is absent.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in industrial production above 0.5% signals robust manufacturing activity and supply chain strength, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when INDPRO rises > 0.5% MoM (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL rises (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE falls below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
